records.rule: Default decimal mathematical context requests 50 digits plus explicit guard digits. Binary64 is opt-in and every lossy transition is evidence.
MathExactNumber -> MathRational -> MathInteger/MathFraction. Canonical denominator-one rational values become MathInteger.
1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 retains natural unreduced path 3/3 and canonicalizes to exact integer 1.
(2/3) * 3 / 2 returns exact MathInteger 1. Decimal formatting may show a rounded expansion but must never alter the stored rational.
For i=1..25, fraction(i,3*i) canonicalizes to 1/3 and multiplication by 3*i returns exact MathInteger(i); no tolerance is permitted.
MathDecimalExpansion represents exact recurring notation such as 2/3 = 0.(6); complete cycle discovery is required before calling an expansion exact.
A proof applies to a MathClaim under MathAssumptions. Outcome and evidence strength are separate.
STANDARD, STRONG, CERTIFIED and DIAGNOSTIC are proof policies. Obligation routes and support routes are distinct.
The adversarial Hilbert solve regression must be capable of returning DISAGREEMENT/CORROBORATION_REQUIRED rather than rubber-stamping plausible binary64 output.
For x in [0,1], direct interval evaluation of 2*x - 2*x can validly enclose [-2,2] while symbolic algebra proves the stronger identity 0. Valid evidence may be weak evidence.
Lossy representations retain payload plus quantization state: scheme, block size, codebook, scales, source/compute/storage dtypes, provider/version and error evidence.
PURE v0.7 reference quantizer supports SYMMETRIC_INT8 and declared-codebook NF4 using exact rational replay over retained represented source values.
Nested/double quantization is represented but PURE execution fails closed until the second representation transition has explicit evidence.
MathPrecisionPolicy preserves exact values by default and can protect semantic roles/small tensors while quantizing eligible approximate tensors.
Use overloaded operators wherever semantics are unambiguous. ooRexx dispatches from the left operand, so exact-object-left forms such as fraction * 3 are the supported lossless route.
Providers supply computation but do not own mathematical meaning, precision policy, claim semantics or proof acceptance.
Assistant-host v0.7 qualification is 269/269 PASS. v0.7 FLINT-ARB 8-assertion lane remains to be rerun on the user's FLINT-enabled host before claiming 277/277.
Next likely exact-algebra work: polynomials/quadratics and optimized simultaneous systems, preserving exact/symbolic/rigorous/numerical proof distinctions.
Future reusable families include tensors, sparse matrices, statistics/distributions, numerical calculus, optimization, stochastic processes, transforms, geometry and graph/network mathematics.
Magrathea may return 42, but satisfaction statistics are not a MathProof.
